---
title: "API Reference"
---

Complete reference for all exported SpectraWeaveR functions, grouped by module.

## Utilities

Core format conversion, FCS I/O, and channel classification helpers.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_read_fcs()`](utils.qmd#sw_read_fcs) | Read FCS files with Aurora-safe defaults |
| [`sw_flowframe_to_tibble()`](utils.qmd#sw_flowframe_to_tibble) | Convert flowFrame to tibble |
| [`sw_tibble_to_flowframe()`](utils.qmd#sw_tibble_to_flowframe) | Convert tibble to flowFrame |
| [`sw_exprs_to_tibble()`](utils.qmd#sw_exprs_to_tibble) | Convert expression matrix to tibble |
| [`sw_get_fluor_channels()`](utils.qmd#sw_get_fluor_channels) | Get fluorescent channel names |
| [`sw_set_marker_names()`](utils.qmd#sw_set_marker_names) | Set marker names on a flowFrame |
| [`sw_are_signal_cols()`](utils.qmd#sw_are_signal_cols) | Identify signal columns |
| [`sw_are_fluor_cols()`](utils.qmd#sw_are_fluor_cols) | Identify fluorochrome columns |
| [`sw_aggregate_and_sample()`](utils.qmd#sw_aggregate_and_sample) | Aggregate and subsample flow frames |
| [`sw_collect_events_retained()`](utils.qmd#sw_collect_events_retained) | Collect events retained at each step |

## Spectral unmixing

AutoSpectral-based spectral unmixing workflow — six functions from step-by-step
control to a one-call orchestrator.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_autospectral_setup()`](unmix.qmd#sw_autospectral_setup) | Initialize AutoSpectral parameters |
| [`sw_prepare_controls()`](unmix.qmd#sw_prepare_controls) | Gate, clean, and extract fluorophore spectra |
| [`sw_extract_af_spectra()`](unmix.qmd#sw_extract_af_spectra) | Extract per-cell autofluorescence spectra |
| [`sw_extract_spectral_variants()`](unmix.qmd#sw_extract_spectral_variants) | Extract spectral variants |
| [`sw_unmix()`](unmix.qmd#sw_unmix) | Unmix spectral flow cytometry data |
| [`sw_unmix_pipeline()`](unmix.qmd#sw_unmix_pipeline) | End-to-end unmixing pipeline |
| [`sw_load_unmixed()`](unmix.qmd#sw_load_unmixed) | Load pre-unmixed FCS files |
| [`sw_remove_margins()`](unmix.qmd#sw_remove_margins) | Remove margin events |

|----------|-------------|

| [`sw_extract_gated()`](gate.qmd#sw_extract_gated) | Extract gated populations |

## Signal QC

Signal quality control with PeacoQC.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_signal_qc()`](qc.qmd#sw_signal_qc) | Signal QC on a single flowFrame |
| [`sw_signal_qc_batch()`](qc.qmd#sw_signal_qc_batch) | Batch signal QC |
| [`sw_qc_summary()`](qc.qmd#sw_qc_summary) | QC summary report |

## Batch correction

Batch correction with cyCombine, including all-in-one and modular workflows,
plus diagnostic evaluation and visualisation.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_prepare_for_correction()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_prepare_for_correction) | Prepare data for batch correction |
| [`sw_batch_correct()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_batch_correct) | All-in-one batch correction |
| [`sw_normalize()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_normalize) | Normalise data (modular step 1) |
| [`sw_create_som()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_create_som) | Create SOM clusters (modular step 2) |
| [`sw_correct_data()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_correct_data) | Apply ComBat correction (modular step 3) |
| [`sw_evaluate_correction()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_evaluate_correction) | Quick evaluation of correction quality |
| [`sw_detect_batch_effect()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_detect_batch_effect) | Detect batch effects |
| [`sw_compute_emd()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_compute_emd) | Compute Earth Mover's Distance |
| [`sw_evaluate_emd()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_evaluate_emd) | Evaluate correction with EMD |
| [`sw_evaluate_mad()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_evaluate_mad) | Evaluate correction with MAD |
| [`sw_plot_batch_densities()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_plot_batch_densities) | Plot marker density by batch |
| [`sw_plot_batch_dimred()`](batch-correct.qmd#sw_plot_batch_dimred) | Plot dimensionality reduction by batch |

| [`sw_cluster_mfis()`](cluster.qmd#sw_cluster_mfis) | Compute MFIs per cluster |

## Composable pipeline

R7/S7-based composable pipeline framework for building custom workflows.

| Function | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| [`sw_step()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step) | Create a processing step |
| [`execute_step()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#execute_step) | Execute a processing step |
| [`sw_pipeline()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline) | Create a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_add()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_add) | Add a step to a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_remove()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_remove) | Remove a step from a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_replace()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_replace) | Replace a step in a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_step_names()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_step_names) | Get step names |
| [`sw_pipeline_length()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_length) | Get number of steps |
| [`sw_pipeline_run()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_run) | Execute a pipeline |
| [`sw_pipeline_concat()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_concat) | Concatenate two pipelines |
| [`sw_pipeline_show()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_pipeline_show) | Print pipeline summary |
| [`sw_plot_pipeline()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_plot_pipeline) | Plot pipeline flowchart |
| [`sw_step_read_fcs()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step_read_fcs) | Step: read FCS files |
| [`sw_step_remove_margins()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step_remove_margins) | Step: remove margin events |
| [`sw_step_signal_qc()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step_signal_qc) | Step: signal QC |
| [`sw_step_batch_correct()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step_batch_correct) | Step: batch correction |
| [`sw_step_normalize()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step_normalize) | Step: normalisation |
| [`sw_step_create_som()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step_create_som) | Step: SOM clustering |
| [`sw_step_correct_data()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step_correct_data) | Step: ComBat correction |
| [`sw_step_cluster()`](composable-pipeline.qmd#sw_step_cluster) | Step: clustering |
